title: Improvising or playing set parts
summary: Dutcher says Dixieland seems improvised. Ridgley says it sounded that way but players worked out parts and played them the same year after year.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
